title: Dhurandhar 2 Is Finally on Your TV. The Raw and Undekha Version Has 30 Minutes You Never Saw.
excerpt: The ₹1,800 crore spy thriller dropped on JioHotstar this week with bonus footage, uncensored dialogue, and behind-the-scenes chaos. Netflix India follows on June 19. Your weekend just got sorted.
body:
Here is the only number that matters: ₹1,800 crore worldwide. That is what Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge collected in its theatrical run — making it the second-highest-grossing Indian film of all time, behind only Dangal. For eleven weeks, it owned every multiplex, every single screen, every conversation in every group chat. And now, as of June 4, it belongs to your living room.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=NHk7scrb_9I

The film started streaming on JioHotstar with a live premiere event at 7 PM, featuring candid cast discussions and behind-the-scenes footage. By midnight, the full film was available on-demand. And this is not just the version you saw in theatres.

Raw and Undekha

The streaming edition, titled Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge (Raw & Undekha), adds roughly 30 minutes of exclusive bonus content — behind-the-scenes moments, cast interactions, candid conversations, and deep dives into the filmmaking process. The film itself includes approximately three minutes of additional footage and uncensored dialogues that were trimmed from the theatrical cut.

"Watched the opening scene of Dhurandhar 2 and it took me straight back to March 19 when I first experienced this peak moment with the sound blasting in my ears. I wish I could relive that again." — Fan on X

The response has been predictable: absolute pandemonium. One viewer posted that Ranveer Singh had "cancelled your weekend plans." Another called the bonus content "truly a delight" and said the re-watch was even more enjoyable than the theatrical experience. A third noted nostalgically that "watching Dhurandhar 2 on Hotstar with ads brings back memories from the 2010s."

https://www.instagram.com/p/DZNlUbyCZhn/

The Dual-Platform Play

What makes this release unusual is its staggered, two-platform strategy. Netflix had already begun streaming the uncut international version — titled Dhurandhar: The Revenge (Raw and Undekha) — in several international markets starting May 15. If you are in the US, UK, Canada, or anywhere outside India, you have likely already had access for weeks.

Now, JioHotstar holds the India-specific streaming rights, with the film available in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam. Netflix India will follow on June 19, two weeks after the JioHotstar premiere. The staggered approach is designed to maximise reach across different subscriber bases — a strategy that trade analysts believe could set a precedent for future mega-releases.

What You Are Watching

Directed by Aditya Dhar, Dhurandhar 2 picks up the story of Hamza Ali Mazari as he embarks on a new mission. Ranveer Singh is in the lead, joined by R. Madhavan, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, Sara Arjun, Rakesh Bedi, and Danish Pandor. The film runs just under four hours — 3 hours 55 minutes — and carries an 8.5 rating on IMDb.

The sequel built on everything the first Dhurandhar established — large-scale action sequences, emotional heft, genuine mass appeal — and then went further. The result was not just a box office record but a cultural event. For weeks after release, it was the only thing Bollywood was talking about.

The Diaspora Angle

For NRIs who caught it on Netflix internationally, the JioHotstar version offers the live premiere bonus content and the cast commentary experience that Netflix did not include. For those who missed the theatrical run entirely — and there were many, given the nearly four-hour runtime and limited weekday showtimes — this is your chance.

The film is available across all five major Indian languages on JioHotstar. Netflix India arrives June 19 with the extended uncut version. Between the two platforms, there is no excuse left.

Here is the truth about Dhurandhar 2: it is not a film that needs convincing. It already convinced 1,800 crore rupees worth of audiences. The streaming release is not about discovery — it is about access. The biggest spy thriller India has ever produced is now a play button away.

Streaming on JioHotstar (India, now). Netflix India from June 19. Netflix (international, already available). Runtime: 3h 55m. Languages: Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam.
